title: Jordan Lee, baggage theft
policy_copy: Baggage. A theft of baggage is covered when a police report is filed within 24 hours. A theft without that report is not covered.
claim_papers: Traveler: Jordan Lee. Loss: baggage theft of $300.00. No police report is attached.
explanation: The baggage section requires a police report within 24 hours for a theft. The papers do not include that report for the $300.00 loss. The claim would be rejected.

mistakes.mistake: No police report for a theft of $300.00
mistakes.reason: The policy requires a police report filed within 24 hours.

activity: Read the baggage section of the policy.
Checked the papers for a police report filed within 24 hours.
